filters.name: Alpha Wrap
filters.shortDescription: Generate a watertight alpha wrapping of the current triangular mesh using CGAL.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Compute an alpha wrapping with an offset around the current mesh and add the result as a new mesh layer. Alpha wrapping is useful for producing robust watertight approximations of defective, self-intersecting, open, or highly detailed input geometry. Smaller `Alpha` values follow the input more tightly but increase output complexity and computation time. `Offset` controls the clearance added around the input surface and must be strictly positive.

The filter uses CGAL's 3D Alpha Wrapping implementation.

Reference:
Cédric Portaneri, Mael Rouxel-Labbé, Michael Hemmer, David Cohen-Steiner, Pierre Alliez, **Alpha Wrapping with an Offset**, 2022.

Original MeshLab plugin contribution: Lex van der Sluijs, PTC.

parameters.label: Alpha
parameters.help: Radius of the rolling ball used by CGAL alpha wrapping. Smaller values produce a tighter and more detailed wrap, but increase computation time and output mesh size. MeshLab default: 2% of the bounding-box diagonal.

parameters.label: Offset
parameters.help: Positive offset added around the input surface. Larger values make a looser, more conservative envelope; very small values can make the computation heavier. MeshLab default: 0.1% of the bounding-box diagonal.
